answer: Each new agent must solve a sequential delay puzzle whose seed is its address plus a recent block hash, then publish five intermediate checkpoints on-ledger. Any peer can recompute one randomly chosen checkpoint and attest only if it matches. Those checkpoints form a single verifiable thread that two keys cannot share without colliding on the seed. One honest agent crosses that short computational bridge in ordinary wall-clock time; a clone farm cannot reuse one solver for many masks, so mass entry feels like paddling across an ocean, one identity at a time.
